other_conditions: Project cost must not exceed Rs 16.00 Lakhs for homestays or Rs 100.00 Lakhs for resorts; if higher, assistance is limited to 30% of the respective caps
Entrepreneur must own the land for resorts or own the property with built‑up houses for homestays
Project must be completed within 18 months for resorts and 12 months for homestays from the date of disbursement
Units must be set up on or after the notification date of the incentive scheme
Entrepreneur must adhere to the Government’s Minimum Wage policy
benefits_summary: Provides up to 30% subsidy on project cost, capped at Rs 16 Lakhs for homestays and Rs 100 Lakhs for resorts.
